prerequisites: Knowledge of Elasticity and Strength of Materials, including deformation compatibility equations, material behavior equations, plane stress, plane strain, axial symmetry, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, stiffness matrix, and equilibrium equations.
Calculation, Design, and Testing of Machines

learning_outcomes.text: The student will know and apply the concepts of simultaneous engineering, conceiving and designing industrial products as a team, working in a network, using the most advanced graphical and simulation techniques.

syllabus_topics: Product design process: Fundamentals, Sequential model, Concurrent model, Conceptual design methodologies, Product specifications, Intellectual property in design
Innovation in Design: Creativity and innovation techniques

Concurrent engineering: Product development process management, Ergonomic design, Value analysis, Quality function deployment, Failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), Technological surveillance for new product development
Sustainable design: Ecodesign methodologies, Environmental product labeling, Product life cycle analysis vs carbon footprint
Product presentation: Graphical information, Product information, Information management, Virtual mock-ups and prototypes, Integrated systems in a collaborative engineering environment
Integral design of a utilitarian product with environmental and innovation criteria
assessment_rules: To pass the course, the student must achieve at least 15% in the written tests and 50% in the sum of all evaluation systems. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the final grade for the course will be 'Fail', with the resulting score from the sum of all evaluation systems, truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points.
